<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/tasks/{id}/lease-renewals"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Pushes out a task's lease expiry so a station still actively working it doesn't lose the claim to the automatic expiry sweep (`POST /task-lease-expirations`). Only the station that currently owns the claim may renew it. Idempotent in effect: repeated calls simply keep extending the same lease.
